omissions.reason: The two deletions in Soit produce Si. Their joint English change Let/If is represented at v0001; this second letter deletion has no additional independent English effect.
The canceled stray b in hyperplane has no English effect; no English misspelling is manufactured.
The inserted n' completes French restrictive n'...que; English only already expresses que, so this particle adds no independent English change.

variant_notes.note: The deletions of o and t jointly change French Soit to Si. The English replacement Let/If records that combined change at this first physical source ID; v0002 has no further English effect and is recorded among the omissions.
